results.content:
# Alternatives to Google Ads for brand awareness

Google Ads captures demand that already exists: someone searches, you appear. It cannot create the demand in the first place. For that the alternatives are Connected TV, billboards, digital screens, metro and cinema, which reach people before they ever search. Publicit sells those self-service, at the prices publishers set themselves, from one dashboard.

See what is available What it costs

Signing up is free. New advertisers get a 100 euro discount on their first campaign payment.

## What Google Ads does that nothing else does

Search advertising answers a question someone is already asking. That is a category of its own, and no billboard competes with it. [...] ## Frequently asked questions

For brand awareness, the alternatives are the channels that build recognition before a search happens: Connected TV, billboards, digital screens, metro and cinema, which Publicit sells self-service. For capturing a search that already exists, search is still the place, so the useful question is what to buy once you already hold that intent.

For the awareness half, yes: it sells the specific physical and CTV spaces that make people recognise a brand before they search for it, at publisher prices. It does not sell search placements or keyword targeting, which is a different job and stays with Google. [...] Nobody is searching for your category yet. A new product, or one that solves a problem people have not named, has no keyword to buy.
 You have already bought all the relevant intent. Once you hold the terms that convert, extra budget buys looser matches at worse rates.
 You need to be the name they search for. When someone searches your category and picks the brand they recognise, that recognition was built somewhere else.

That "somewhere else" is the actual alternative: channels that reach people before there is a search at all.

## The channels that create demand instead of capturing it

Every channel, free and paid, with what it costs to start on each, is in where to advertise your business.
